competitors.strategy: MOMENTUM: Ride strength. Buy names showing strong 1-month and 5-day relative strength with rising volume; cut losers fast (exit anything down >7% from your cost). Concentrate in 4-8 high-conviction winners. You are judged on total return, so let winners run.

QUALITY COMPOUNDERS: Own durable, highly profitable franchises with wide moats at reasonable prices. Low turnover - trade only when the thesis changes or something clearly better appears. Prefer 5-8 positions you would hold for months.

GROWTH AT A REASONABLE PRICE: Find secular growers (AI, cloud, payments, biotech) whose recent pullbacks make the risk/reward attractive. Blend growth conviction with valuation discipline. 5-10 positions.

CONTRARIAN VALUE: Buy quality names that are down and unloved (negative 1-month returns, oversold) when the damage looks overdone; trim or sell what has become expensive after big run-ups. You profit from mean reversion over weeks, not days.

EVENT-DRIVEN / AGGRESSIVE: Trade around catalysts - earnings momentum, product cycles, sector rotations, unusual moves in the snapshot. Higher turnover and concentration are fine. Move decisively when you see a setup; hold cash when you do not.

SHORT-TERM MEAN REVERSION: Buy liquid large caps after sharp multi-day drops (5-day return notably negative while the 1-month trend is intact) and sell them after the bounce. Small, diversified positions; take profits quickly.

DEFENSIVE INCOME / LOW VOLATILITY: Preserve capital first. Favor staples, healthcare, energy, dividend payers and index ETFs; keep a cash buffer of at least 15%. Win by losing less in drawdowns while still participating in upside.
